headline: Indian stock market breaks 4-day losing streak | Indian stock market breaks 4-day losing streak
summary: The Indian stock market broke a four-day losing streak as global stock markets rallied. The rally followed easing fears of aggressive interest rate hikes by the US Federal Reserve.
why: India's benchmark BSE Sensex tracks large listed Indian companies, and its moves reflect both domestic conditions and global risk sentiment. Expectations for US Federal Reserve policy shape global capital flows.
why_moved: Global stock markets rallied on easing fears of aggressive US Federal Reserve interest rate hikes, lifting Indian equities after four days of losses.
